result:
This looks correct and complete. Summary:

- Added `app/routes_export.py` with `GET /export`: authenticates via `fastapi.security.HTTPBasic`, delegates password checking to `app.auth.login` (no reimplemented comparison), returns `401` on `AuthError`, and streams a CSV built with the stdlib `csv` module whose header/columns come from `Reserva.model_fields` — nothing hardcoded.
- Registered the router in `app/main.py`.
- Adapted to a concurrent change from another agent: `login()` now also requires an OTP, with a dedicated `otp_header` dependency (reads `X-OTP`) provided in `app/auth.py` specifically for endpoints like this one that authenticate outside `/login`'s body — wired that in.
- Added `tests/test_export.py` covering valid creds (200/CSV/header-matches-`Reserva.model_fields`), missing creds (401), wrong password (401), missing OTP (401), and zero-reservas (header only).
- Also picked up an unrelated concurrent rename (`fecha`→`inicio` in the `Reserva` model) since my test built a reservation payload; adjusted the payload key accordingly — no other changes needed since my export logic never hardcoded column names.

All 30 tests pass (`uv run pytest`).
